residual_note: Studies the classifier kept but whose title or conditions name an anesthesia or procedural term. Retained deliberately: many are psychiatric trials that merely mention a procedural agent (a psychedelic masked with propofol). The exclusion count above is what was removed, not a claim that the category is now empty.

rules.rule: HealingMaps listings NOT tagged as a psychedelic/psychedelic-therapy category (GLP-1, peptide, generic wellness clinics the source also lists). Historical: the 2026-09-02 harvest; the source has refused us since

ClinicalTrials.gov records matching a search term but carrying NO psychedelic intervention (93 when the rule began on 2026-09-02; 0 since, because the harvester now queries only the intervention field)

rules.rule: Studies whose indication is anesthesia/analgesia/procedural-sedation, sharing only a molecule (ketamine) with the therapeutic field

rules.rule: Trial-site rows belonging to anesthesia/analgesia studies above

rules.rule: Psychedelic term appears only in the abstract and the title is not clinical — a passing mention (how a COVID-19 meta-analysis and a Japan-Hungary diplomatic history entered the corpus before 2026-10-02)
rules.enforced_by: is_relevant() in scope.py; scope = psychedelic medicine

rules.rule: Returned by the search but no psychedelic term in title or abstract
Psychedelic is the title subject but the framing is humanities, ethnography, taxonomy or cultivation, not medicine
'Microdosing' in the title without any psychedelic named: pharmacology's phase-0 microdose (oncology, fertility, veterinary anaesthesia)
Phencyclidine (PCP) or MK-801 is the title's only drug: pharmacology's psychosis-model NMDA antagonists, in on a ketamine mention in the abstract
Non-treatment organizations (law firms, funders, regulators, advocacy groups, drug developers) reclassified out of the clinics layer — they remain in the industry layer
Duplicate operator rows collapsed (same name and country, city missing or contained)
rules.enforced_by: second-pass dedupe in merge_master.py; every merge logged to dedupe_merges.csv

rules.rule: One licensee listed twice (legal name and dba) folded on its state licence and website
rules.enforced_by: licence fold in merge_master.py; logged to dedupe_merges.csv

rules.rule: Contact values stripped as source-template leaks (e.g. an NIMH inquiry address printed on hundreds of unrelated clinic listings)
rules.enforced_by: shared-contact guard in merge_master.py; values logged to shared_contacts_stripped.csv
